name: Remove Fatigue, Mass
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bloodlord 4, cleric/oracle 4, druid 4, inquisitor 4, paladin 4, shaman 4

Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions as remove fatigue, except as noted above.
